name: S1200P-8G-2S-AUTO_EN.doc
method: soffice→docx→python-docx(段落+表格+文本框+页眉页脚)
text:
Model	S1200P-8G-2S-AUTO
Product mame	24V/48V automatic matching 2SFP+8GE full Gigabit POE switch
Fixed Port	8*10/100/1000Base-TX PoE port（Data/Power） / 2*1000M SFP
PoE Ports	8*24V/48V automatically identify the matching POE port / 1-8 port support detection 24V power supply, max 30W/port / 1-8 port supports IEEE802.3af/at, max 30W/port, PoE out
PoE Pin	48V: 12+ 36- / 24V: 45+ 78
PoE Bridge	max 150W
PoE Dog	support / PoE auto execution、detection and resets fault device,when PoE is on
Function	N:(Standard normal) / V:(Port isolation) / S:(Super mode)(specific port refers to user manual)
Bandwidth	20Gbps
Packet Forwarding	14.88Mpps
MAC	4K
Buffer	2.5M
Transmission Distance	10BASE-T ： Cat3,4,5 UTP(≤250 meter) / 100BASE-TX ： Cat5 or later UTP(150 meter) / 1000BASE-TX ： Cat6 or later UTP(150 meter) / SFP: 1000M single and multimode optical module with maximum distance ≤ 120km (depending on the optical module)
LED Indicator	P:Power LED(over-power LED) / 9-10:SFP connection indicator / PoE:48V ON: orange light is always on; 24V ON: orange light flashes / Link:10/100/1000M(green)
Power	Built-in power AC：100-240Vac 50-60Hz 1.9A   max 158W
Operating Temperature/Humidity	-10～+55°C；5%～90% RH Non coagulation
Storage Temperature/Humidity	-40～+75°C；5%～95% RH Non coagulation
Product /Packing / size（L*W*H）	206mm*140mm*45mm / 265mm*220mm*68mm
N.W/G.W（kg）	1.1kg/1.3kg
Lightning / Protection  level	6KV 8/20us； / IP30
Installation	Desktop (optional wall +machine hangers)
Certificate	CE-EMC EN55032；CE-LVD EN62368；
FCC Part 15 Class B；RoHS；
Warranty	Whole device for 1 year(Accessories not included)
